title: 第15章 公开对决第16章 权谋棋局
lines: 金色阶梯尽头，星纹王子把白金长剑插进审判场中央。
环形金纹从剑尖下铺开，一圈接一圈封住上层赛区。三重金焰在他身后升起，胸甲中央的皇族纹章缓缓旋转，三息一合，三息一开。
王子抬手指向洛晖掌中的星炎徽章。
“交出徽章，跪下。非王血者进入王血之门相关区域，先受皇族审查。”
洛晖站在阶梯最后一级。
旧皮甲被燃烧沙漠烧出裂口，左腕监控环还在发红。星炎徽章贴着掌心，背面的蓝金路径被他压住。胸前铜星坠一下一下发烫，旧矿坑货单里的封印钉拓印也在衣内顶着皮肤。
他抬起手腕，敲了敲监控环。
“我来试炼塔，不是给你们皇族补一场跪拜礼。想收门票也行，先把第一关碑心黑火解释清楚。”
王令广场观礼阵把这句话放到外庭。
平民席立刻炸开。铁卫长枪敲击石阶，还是压不住人群里的喊声。
贵族席有人拍案。
“放肆！”
“侮辱王血！”
洛晖抬头朝观礼阵方向摆摆手。
“别急着骂，排队。刚才沙漠里骂我的贵族已经免费体验传送服务，你们要升级套餐？”
星纹王子拔出白金长剑。
“废墟镇的口舌救不了你。皇族守护星炎试炼三百年，王血之门只承认正统。”
“守三百年，碑心还藏黑星火。”洛晖把星炎徽章扣进护腕，“守成这样，也好意思写进族谱？我建议加一页：防务外包失败案例。”
宫廷法师团首席在观礼阵下方举起法杖。
“上层赛区临时追加星纹资格审查。洛晖接触黑星残焰，且非王血参试者涉入王血之门方位，需由皇族最终确认。”
显曜在学院观察台站起，权杖点在石面。
“洛晖接触黑星残焰，是清除污染。试炼塔已降下第一关通过印记。学院要求记录完整规则变更。”
宫廷法师团没有退。
“皇族保留最终解释权。”
铁卫监控席上，长夏抬手按下黑钢钮。特别处置队腰侧钉匣同时打开，剥纹钉寒白光排成一线。
长夏展开旧律卷轴。
“洛晖在审查对决中若触发星纹失控、攻击王血之门投影核心、黑星污染反噬任一异常，铁卫团执行紧急处置，剥夺星纹。”
监控环猛地收紧。
洛晖左腕皮肤被勒出一圈血痕。他活动了一下手指，蓝火从指缝钻出半寸，又被监控环压回纹路。
“王子负责喊正统，法师负责改规则，铁卫负责扒皮。”洛晖抬起右手，蓝金火刃在掌心凝成，“分工挺细。曜都公务员培训没白交学费。”
绮兰坐在绮氏贵族席，镶星晶手套按住一枚契约晶片。宫廷法师团刚才说出的每个字，都被银紫细纹烙进晶片。
她放出一只微光纸鹤。
纸鹤绕过监控阵，落在洛晖肩侧，化作一行细字。
胸甲纹章，三息重构，第三息防御最薄。
洛晖没有回头，只把助力符残余微光压入护腕。监控环仍在收紧，星火频率被他压成一线。
王子看见纸鹤碎光，长剑指向绮氏席。
“绮兰，绮氏干涉皇族审判？”
绮兰指尖按着契约晶片。
“绮氏记录试炼。跪拜这种事，绮氏今日没排班。”
贵族席又乱了。
学院旧实验室隔离间内，绮雯坐在暗影阵中央。暗影投射贴在墙上，映出上层赛区。她右腕暗星印记发黑，暗影之刃刃心那缕蓝色净火贴住腕骨。
厄迦残留低语从印记里挤出。
“洛沉坐标重连。王血之门开。”
绮雯咬破指尖，在影纹上写下字。
王子胸甲连接底层门廊。纹章碎裂时，路径会现。让洛晖用星炎徽章接住。
content_en:
At the end of the golden stairs, Prince Star Pattern inserted the platinum sword into the center of the trial field.
Ring-shaped golden patterns spread out from under the tip of the sword, sealing the upper competition area circle after circle. Three layers of golden flames rose behind him, and the royal crest in the center of the breastplate slowly rotated, closing with three breaths and opening with three breaths.
The prince raised his hand and pointed at the Star Flame badge in Luo Hui's palm.
"Hand over the badge and kneel down. Those who are not of King's blood will be examined by the royal family before entering the area related to the King's Blood Gate."
Luo Hui stood on the last step of the stairs.
The old leather armor had cracks burned by the burning desert, and the monitoring ring on his left wrist was still red. The Star Flame Badge was pressed against his palm, and the blue-gold path on the back was pressed down by him. The copper star on his chest felt hot every now and then, and the sealing nail imprints in the old mine cargo list were also pressing against his skin under his clothes.
He raised his wrist and tapped the monitoring ring.
"I came to the trial tower not to make up for the kneeling ceremony for you royal family. You can also charge tickets if you want. First, I will explain the first level of the black fire in the heart of the monument clearly."
The Wang Ling Square viewing array placed this sentence in the outer court.
The civilian seats immediately exploded. The Iron Guards' spears rapped on the stone steps, but they still couldn't suppress the shouts from the crowd.
Someone in the aristocratic seat made a scene.
"Presumptuous!"
"Insult the king's blood!"
Luo Hui raised his head and waved his hand in the direction of the viewing array.
"Don't rush to scold me, get in line. The noble who scolded me in the desert just now has already experienced the teleportation service for free. Do you want to upgrade your package?"
Prince Xingwen drew out his platinum sword.
"The words of Ruin Town can't save you. The Royal Guardian Star Flame has been tried for three hundred years, and the King's Blood Sect only recognizes orthodoxy."
"After three hundred years of defense, there is still a black spark hidden in the heart of the monument." Luo Hui put the Star Flame badge into his wristband, "How dare you write it into your family tree after you have defended it like this? I suggest adding a page: Cases of failed defense outsourcing."
The chief of the palace mage group raised his staff under the viewing array.
"The upper-level competition area has temporarily added a star pattern qualification review. Luo Hui comes into contact with the Black Star Remnant Flame, and non-king blood test participants are involved in the location of the king blood gate, which needs to be finally confirmed by the royal family."
Xian Yao stood up on the observation platform of the college, his scepter pointed on the stone surface.
"Luo Hui came into contact with the remaining flames of the Black Star to remove the pollution. The trial tower has lowered the mark of passing the first level. The academy requires that the complete rule changes be recorded."
The court mage group did not retreat.
"The royal family reserves the right of final interpretation."
On the Iron Guard monitoring seat, Chang Xia raised his hand and pressed the black steel button. The nail boxes on the waist side of the special disposal team were opened at the same time, and the peeling nails were lined up in a line with cold white light.
Chang Xia unfolded the old law scroll.
"If Luo Hui triggers the star pattern to go out of control during the review duel, attacks the projection core of the King's Blood Gate, or black star pollution backfires on any anomaly, the Iron Guard will perform emergency measures and strip away the star pattern."
The monitoring ring tightened suddenly.
The skin of Luo Hui's left wrist was strangled with a circle of blood. He moved his fingers, and the blue fire came out half an inch from between his fingers, and was pressed back into the lines by the monitoring ring.
"The prince is responsible for shouting the orthodoxy, the mage is responsible for changing the rules, and the iron guard is responsible for peeling off the skin." Luo Hui raised his right hand, and the blue-gold fire blade condensed in the palm of his hand. "The division of labor is very fine. Yaodu civil servant training is not in vain."
Qilan was sitting in the Qi family's noble seat, holding a contract chip in her star crystal-encrusted gloves. Every word just spoken by the court mage group was burned into the chip with fine lines of silver and purple.
She released a shimmering paper crane.
The paper crane bypassed the monitoring array and landed on Luo Hui's shoulder, turning into a line of fine characters.
Breastplate emblem, reconstructed in three breaths, the third breath has the weakest defense.
Luo Hui didn't look back, he just pressed the remaining faint light of the booster talisman into his wrist guard. The monitoring ring is still tightening, and the Spark frequency is suppressed by him.
The prince saw the paper crane shatter into pieces and his long sword pointed at Qi's mat.
"Qilan, is the Qi family interfering in the royal trial?"
Qilan pressed the contract chip with her fingertips.
"Qishi records the trial. There is no such thing as kneeling down and worshiping. Qishi has no schedule today."
The noble seats were in chaos again.
In the isolation room of the college's old laboratory, Qiwen sat in the center of the shadow array. Shadow projections cling to the walls, reflecting the upper level. The dark star mark on her right wrist turned black, and the blue pure fire at the center of the Shadow Blade stuck to the wrist bone.
Erga's remaining whispers squeezed out of the mark.
"The coordinates of Luo Chen are reconnected. The Gate of King's Blood is open."
Qiwen bit her fingertips and wrote on the shadow pattern.
The Prince's Breastplate connects to the ground floor porch. When the coat of arms is shattered, the path will appear. Let Luo Hui catch it with the Star Flame Badge.
